powers.name: Plane Shift

powers.name: Gate
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Gate to the plane keyed to a side.

summary: 3 charges: Plane Shift or Gate to one of six planes keyed to its sides.
text: This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the DM. The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 of the cube's charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube: Gate (opening a portal to the plane keyed to the side pressed) or Plane Shift (transporting the targets to the plane keyed to the side pressed). (The Mists of Barovia let nobody leave.)
